hypotheses: Scaling the ingestion worker to zero caused the Redis ingestion queue to grow above the anomaly band.
The API remained available and accepted documents, so ingestion capacity rather than request admission caused the backlog.

falsifying_checks.check: Compare queue depth against the upper band while checking desired worker replicas.
falsifying_checks.result: Queue depth was 20, upper band was 3 and desired worker replicas were 0.

falsifying_checks.check: Restore the saved replica count and verify drain and document completion.
falsifying_checks.result: Worker returned to one available replica, queue depth returned to zero and 20 synthetic documents reached ready.

root_cause.observed: The worker was deliberately scaled to zero before 20 unique documents were accepted.
root_cause.inferred: Removing ingestion capacity caused the Redis queue backlog.
root_cause.unknown: The lab does not estimate production throughput from this single-worker recovery.

actions: Restored the worker to its saved replica count of one.
Confirmed queue depth zero, one available worker and 20 ready synthetic documents.
